question: Sheet(s) control input, high side switch do not carry a U-reference, and a word in the architecture text matches an active-part role. Read each sheet's own title and its typed requirements against the whole BOM. Is the matched role a part the design implements on another sheet (so this sheet only references it), or does the sheet itself promise an active part that no sheet implements?
options: the sheet only references that part, which is implemented on another sheet
the sheet itself promises an active part the design does not build anywhere
value: the sheet itself promises an active part the design does not build anywhere
